description_en: Creates or updates an image baseline strategy
name: SaveImageBaselineStrategy

parameters.help_en:
The baseline items.

You can call the [DescribeImageBaselineStrategy](~~DescribeImageBaselineStrategy~~) API to obtain the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
基线子项列表。
调用[DescribeImageBaselineStrategy](~~DescribeImageBaselineStrategy~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: baseline_item_list

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the baseline check strategy.

You can call the [DescribeImageBaselineStrategy](~~DescribeImageBaselineStrategy~~) API to obtain the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
基线检查策略ID。
调用[DescribeImageBaselineStrategy](~~DescribeImageBaselineStrategy~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: strategy_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the baseline check strategy
parameters.name: strategy_name

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Default value: zh. Valid values:

zh: Chinese.

en: English
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh。取值：

zh：中文。
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The data source. If you do not specify this parameter, the operation queries image baseline strategies by default. Valid values:

default: image

agentless: agentless
parameters.help_zh:
数据来源，为空时默认查询镜像基线策略。取值：
default：镜像
agentless：agentless
parameters.name: source

parameters.help_en: The baseline risk retention period, in days
parameters.help_zh: 基线风险保留时长，单位是天
parameters.name: image_vul_clean
